ZONETHESPIRE-BURIED_AUTOMATON.pages.BURI:
You shovel scrap over the automaton until its eye goes dark. While you're at it, you toss in a few things you don't need.

The edges are [red][jitter]sharp[/jitter][/red].
Your hands will heal.
ZONETHESPIRE-BURIED_AUTOMATON.pages.INIT:
A [orange]huge automaton[/orange] lies half-buried in a mound of scrap. Its chest plate has been torn clean off.

One eye still [sine][aqua]flickers[/aqua][/sine]. When you step closer, its fingers [jitter]scrape[/jitter] at the rust.

[b]Clink. Clink.[/b]

It's still running. Barely.
Remove up to [blue]{ScrapyardRules.BuryMaxCards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Lose [red]{ScrapyardRules.BuryHpLoss}[/red] HP.
You need more than [red]{ScrapyardRules.BuryHpLoss}[/red] HP and a card that can be removed.
Add [red]Scrapyard Automaton[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. It becomes [gold]Automaton Form[/gold] after [blue]{ScrapyardRules.AutomatonCombats}[/blue] combats.
You have no cards that can be [gold]Transformed[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-BURIED_AUTOMATON.pages.REBO:
You find a loose wire and jam it back where it belongs.

[b][jitter]WHRRR-CLUNK![/jitter][/b]

The [orange]automaton[/orange] sits up and starts following you. It is very slow and very loud.
Maybe it just needs to warm up.
ZONETHESPIRE-BURIED_AUTOMATON.pages.STRI:
You pry off a handful of [gold]gears[/gold] and a coil of [aqua]glowing cable[/aqua].

You spend a while bolting them onto your equipment. It works differently now.
Probably better?
ZONETHESPIRE-BURIED_AUTOMATON.title: The Buried Automaton
ZONETHESPIRE-FORGOTTEN_EMPEROR.pages.BOW:
You bow low. Then lower, until your forehead touches the dust.

[sine][purple]“Your strength serves the Empire now.”[/purple][/sine]

When you stand up, you feel like your will now belongs to you a little less.
ZONETHESPIRE-FORGOTTEN_EMPEROR.pages.BRO:
You grab the emperor's nose and give it a twist.

[b][jitter]CRACK![/jitter][/b]

A puff of [green]strangely refreshing[/green] dust blows out of the hole.
He had it coming.
ZONETHESPIRE-FORGOTTEN_EMPEROR.pages.INI:
A [purple]marble statue[/purple] of an emperor stands in the dust, its face worn smooth. Nobody remembers his name.

His [gold]crown[/gold] has fallen off and lies at his feet, [aqua]calcified[/aqua] to the floor.

You feel a strong urge to [sine]bow[/sine].
You have no Powers in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-FORGOTTEN_EMPEROR.pages.TOO:
You pry the [gold]crown[/gold] loose. It is heavier than it looks and cold as stone.

You put it on. Nobody stops you.
The emperor keeps staring at nothing.
ZONETHESPIRE-FORGOTTEN_EMPEROR.title: The Forgotten Emperor
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.ditchPrompt: Choose [blue]{FrostfallenRules.DitchCards}[/blue] cards to bind frost to.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.pages.CUT.descr:
You get the blade under your thigh and cut until the ice lets you go.

Under a minute. Fast work.

It doesn't close right. Not in this cold.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.pages.DITCHED.d:
You cut the straps and let the [gold]pack[/gold] go. The snow swallows it.

You haul out on your elbows and lie there a while, lighter and poorer.

What you kept is cold to the touch now.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.pages.INITIAL.d:
You take three steps onto the [blue]snowfield[/blue] and drop straight through.

It packs in around your legs and sets like stone. Every kick packs it tighter.
Your feet stopped hurting a while ago.

The wind is getting up. Something here is going to cost you...
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.pages.INITIAL.o: Lose [gold]{Relic}[/gold] and [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Choose [blue]3[/blue] cards to gain [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] [blue]{FrostfallenRules.DitchColdPerCost}[/blue] per energy they cost.
Lose [gold]{Relic}[/gold]. Choose [blue]3[/blue] cards to gain [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] [blue]{FrostfallenRules.DitchColdPerCost}[/blue] per energy they cost.
You have nothing you could leave behind.
Lose [red]{FrostfallenRules.StruggleHpLoss}[/red] HP. Choose [blue]1[/blue] card to gain [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] [blue]{FrostfallenRules.StruggleColdPerCost}[/blue] per energy it costs.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.pages.STRUGGLED:
A finger's width at a time, you work one leg out. Then the other.

Something in your knee [red]pops[/red] on the way.

You limp off. One thing you carried came out white with frost.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.strugglePrompt: Choose [blue]{FrostfallenRules.StruggleCards}[/blue] card to bind frost to.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTFALLEN.title: Frostfallen
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_THRONE.pages.GRASPED:
You take hold of the [orange]sceptre[/orange]. Its warmth crawls up your arm and into your fingers.

Now everything you touch [gold]glitters[/gold] a little.
It also [red]stings[/red] a little.
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_THRONE.pages.INITIAL:
Everything in this hall is [gold]solid gold[/gold]. The tables, the curtains, a servant halfway through a bow.

On the throne sits a [gold]golden king[/gold]. One hand is held out, palm up. The other grips a [orange]sceptre[/orange] that is still [sine]warm[/sine].

He is clearly waiting for something.

[gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card and make it [gold]Gilded[/gold]. [gold]Gilded[/gold] cards give [blue]{HallsOfMidasRules.GildedGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and cost [red]{HallsOfMidasRules.GildedHpLoss}[/red] HP when played.
You have no cards that can be [gold]Gilded[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_THRONE.pages.POCKETE:
You stuff your pockets until they sag.

On the way out, you notice the servant's golden head has turned to [sine]follow you[/sine].
Someone will want this back.
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_THRONE.pages.TRIBUTE:
You drop the coins into the king's palm.

[b][jitter]GRIND.[/jitter][/b]

The golden fingers close, then open again. The coins are gone. Something else is sitting there instead.
Fair trade.
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_THRONE.title: The Golden Throne
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_WORM.pages.CRUSHED.d:
You bring your heel down. The shell [jitter]cracks[/jitter], and the worm goes still.

You feel [green]refreshed[/green], somehow.
You also feel like a monster.
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_WORM.pages.EATEN.des:
You swallow it whole. It goes down [jitter]slowly[/jitter].

A while later, patches of your skin feel [gold]hard as stone[/gold], and something inside you [green]squirms[/green].
You try not to think about it.
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_WORM.pages.INITIAL.d:
[b][jitter]CRUNCH.[/jitter][/b]

You've stepped on something. It's a [orange]worm[/orange] in a shell of [gold]polished marble[/gold].
It isn't hurt.

It lifts its little stone head and [sine]wriggles[/sine] at you. Your stomach makes a noise.

That can't be a good idea.
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_WORM.pages.INITIAL.o: Make a card that gains [gold]Block[/gold] [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold] and [gold]{@infestation.wriggling}[/gold]. Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP.
You have no cards that gain [gold]Block[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_WORM.title: Marble Worm
ZONETHESPIRE-OTHER_YOU.pages.INITIAL.des:
A [aqua]tall mirror[/aqua] stands alone in the middle of the path. No frame. No wall behind it.

Your reflection waves at you.
You did not wave.

[sine][blue]“Hello! I've been waiting. Want to switch places for a bit?”[/blue][/sine]
ZONETHESPIRE-OTHER_YOU.pages.INITIAL.opt: Choose a card. Add a copy of it to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Lose [red]{MirrorRules.ShakeHandsMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP.
Your Max HP is too low.
Obtain [blue]{MirrorRules.SmashItRelics}[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold]. Add [red]Bad Luck[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
[gold]Enchant[/gold] a card with [purple]Glam[/purple]. Add [red]Shame[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
You have no cards that can be [gold]Enchanted[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-OTHER_YOU.pages.SHOOK_HANDS:
You reach out. Your reflection reaches back, and your hands [sine]meet in the glass[/sine].

For a moment there are two of you.
When you let go, part of you [red]stays in the glass[/red].
ZONETHESPIRE-OTHER_YOU.pages.SMASHED.des:
[b][jitter]CRASH![/jitter][/b]

The mirror falls to pieces. A handful of [gold]shiny[/gold] things lie where your reflection stood.

[sine][blue]“Seven years!”[/blue][/sine] a small voice calls from the shards.
ZONETHESPIRE-OTHER_YOU.pages.TURNED_AWAY:
You turn your back on the mirror. Behind you, your reflection keeps [sine]waving[/sine].

You close your eyes and look inward instead. Something in there [gold]shines[/gold].

Your face is still [red]burning[/red].
ZONETHESPIRE-OTHER_YOU.title: The Other You
ZONETHESPIRE-SINGING_LODESTONE.attunePro: Choose up to [blue]{FerrosandRules.AttuneMaxCards}[/blue] cards to make [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-SINGING_LODESTONE.pages.ATT:
You stand against the stone until the iron sand [sine]clings[/sine] to you.

Now each move you make pulls the next one along.
Your skin is [red]rubbed raw[/red].
ZONETHESPIRE-SINGING_LODESTONE.pages.CHA:
You put both hands flat on the stone. The hum climbs higher and higher.

[b][jitter]ZZZAP![/jitter][/b]

Your arms [aqua]crackle[/aqua] with new strength. Your chest feels [red]heavier[/red].
ZONETHESPIRE-SINGING_LODESTONE.pages.INI:
A huge [purple]black lodestone[/purple] sticks out of the dunes. It [sine]hums[/sine]. You can feel it in your teeth.

Iron sand crawls up its sides in slow streams. Your belt buckle tugs toward it.
So does everything else you own.
Choose up to [blue]{FerrosandRules.AttuneMaxCards}[/blue] cards to make [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold]. Lose [red]{FerrosandRules.AttuneHpLoss}[/red] HP.
You need more than [red]{FerrosandRules.AttuneHpLoss}[/red] HP and a card that can be [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold].
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] up to [blue]{FerrosandRules.ChargeMaxCards}[/blue] [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold] cards. Lose [red]{FerrosandRules.ChargeMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP.
You have no [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold] cards that can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-SINGING_LODESTONE.pages.SIF:
You dig through the sand. It keeps [sine]sliding back[/sine] toward the stone, which is annoying.

Still, you come up with a few [gold]coins[/gold] and a small bottle.
Not bad.
ZONETHESPIRE-SINGING_LODESTONE.title: The Singing Lodestone
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_COLOUR_THIEF.pages.INIT:
A small grey creature sits on a rock, hugging a [rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1]bundle of colours[/rainbow]. Everything around it is grey too. The grass. The rocks. The tips of your boots.

It notices you and grins.

[sine][purple]“Trade?”[/purple][/sine]
[gold]Transform[/gold] every [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into random 0-cost cards from other characters.
You have no Strikes or Defends.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_COLOUR_THIEF.pages.PATT:
You pat it on the head. It looks surprised, then climbs onto your shoulder.

It has decided to come with you.
Your pockets already feel lighter.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_COLOUR_THIEF.pages.SNAT:
You grab the bundle and run.

It [red][jitter]bites[/jitter][/red] you on the way out. It has a lot of teeth for something so small.
The bundle is still [sine]warm[/sine].
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_COLOUR_THIEF.pages.TRAD:
It peels the colour right off you, like a sticker.

Then it hands you some of its own. They're small and light, and they don't quite match.
You'll get used to them.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_COLOUR_THIEF.title: The Colour Thief
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.pages.DARK.desc:
You step into the dark. It's quiet in there, and very cold.

When you come back out, some of your things are heavier.
They [purple]hum[/purple] when you hold them.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.pages.INITIAL.d:
The sky splits in two. One half burns with a hard [aqua]rainbow light[/aqua]. The other half is simply [purple]gone[/purple].

Where they meet, the ground shows two shadows of you. One of them is waving.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.pages.INITIAL.o: [blue]{EclipseRules.LookChancePercent}%[/blue]: obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold] and heal to full. Otherwise, lose [red]{EclipseRules.LookMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP.
Your Max HP is too low.
A random card gains an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] copy in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The original becomes [purple]Shadow Corrupted[/purple].
You have no cards that can be [purple]Shadow Corrupted[/purple].
Make [blue]{EclipseRules.DarkCorruptCount}[/blue] random cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] [purple]Shadow Corrupted[/purple].
You have no cards that can be [purple]Shadow Corrupted[/purple].
Choose [blue]{EclipseRules.LightTransformCount}[/blue] cards to [gold]Transform[/gold] into cards of other characters. They are [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
You have no cards that can be transformed.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.pages.LIGHT.des:
You walk into the light until your eyes water. Everything you carry comes out a different [aqua]colour[/aqua].

Some of it isn't yours anymore.
It's better.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.pages.LOOKED_BL:
You stare right at it. The ring of fire burns a hole straight through you.

When you can see again, you feel [green]wonderful[/green].
Something shiny is lying at your feet.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.pages.LOOKED_BU:
You stare right at it. The ring of fire burns a hole straight through you.

When you can see again, part of you is [red]still missing[/red].
You should have known better.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.pages.SPLIT.des:
You step onto the seam. Your two shadows pull in opposite directions, and something in your pack tears in half.

Both halves come with you.
Only one of them [purple]whispers[/purple].
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_ECLIPSE.title: The Eclipse
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_FERMENTING_VAT.pages.DR:
You fill the ladle and drink.

It tastes like old socks and burnt bread. Your stomach [jitter]lurches[/jitter]. When it settles, it is tougher than before.

The aftertaste follows you out.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_FERMENTING_VAT.pages.FE:
You uncork your potions one by one and pour them in.

[sine][green]Glorp. Glorp. Glorp.[/green][/sine]

The vat lets out a long belch. The fumes clear your head, and a few old tricks come back sharper.

Your belt feels very light.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_FERMENTING_VAT.pages.IN:
Behind a row of cold stills stands a copper [gold]vat[/gold] twice your height. Whatever is inside has been fermenting for a very long time.

A ladle hangs from the rim.

[sine][green]Blorp.[/green][/sine]
The vat burps. It sounds hungry.
Gain [green]{FermentingVatRules.DrinkMaxHp}[/green] Max HP. Add a random [red]Curse[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
You have no cards that can be upgraded.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_FERMENTING_VAT.title: The Fermenting Vat
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_LANTERN_BEARER.pages.IN:
A hunched thing shuffles out of the dark. Its skin is grey and flaking, and it can't stop apologising.

“Sorry. So sorry. It's yours now.” It presses a small lantern into your hands. “Keep it lit. It keeps them back.”

Behind you, something whispers.
[purple][jitter]“Smash the lantern... free yourself... forsake him...”[/jitter][/purple]
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_LANTERN_BEARER.pages.SM:
Glass bursts across the stones. The dark rolls off your shoulders like water.

The creature doesn't scream. It just stands there as the shadows fold over it, still whispering sorry.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_LANTERN_BEARER.pages.TA:
You hook the lantern to your belt. Its flame is small and stubborn.

The creature bows, weeping, and wanders off lighter than it came.
The whispering follows you instead.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_LANTERN_BEARER.title: The Lantern Bearer
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SACRED_TRIBUNAL.pages.C:
You tell the eye everything. It takes a while.

The scale tips. Something scrapes out of your chest on its way up, and the wound it leaves heals over tough.

The eye shuts.
Case closed.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SACRED_TRIBUNAL.pages.D:
[blue]“I have done nothing wrong.”[/blue]

The eye stares. The scale doesn't move.

Then every muscle you own goes hot, and a [red]red thread[/red] of light stitches itself under your skin.

You walk out stronger.
It keeps watching.

You swear yourself to the light. The eye blinks, slowly, twice.

A [gold]burning flail[/gold] drops into your open hands. To make room for it, you forget a few tricks you were proud of.

Worth it. Probably.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SACRED_TRIBUNAL.pages.I:
The light down this corridor is so bright you walk it with your eyes shut.

When you open them, you are kneeling. A [gold]golden scale[/gold] hangs in front of you. Above it, an [purple]eye[/purple] the size of a door blinks once.

[sine][purple]“SPEAK.”[/purple][/sine]
Lose [red]{TribunalRules.ConfessHpCost}[/red] HP. Remove [gold]{@hallowed.blasphemous}[/gold] and [gold]{@hallowed.redemption}[/gold] from all your cards. Gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] Max HP.
Lose [red]{TribunalRules.ConfessHpCost}[/red] HP. Remove [gold]{@hallowed.blasphemous}[/gold] from all your cards.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] every card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] that isn't upgraded. Each one without [gold]{@hallowed.redemption}[/gold] also gains [gold]{@hallowed.blasphemous}[/gold].
Every card you have is already upgraded.
Add [gold]Inquisitor's Wrath[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [blue]{TribunalRules.DevoteDowngrades}[/blue] random upgraded cards are downgraded.
You need at least [blue]{TribunalRules.DevoteDowngrades}[/blue] upgraded cards.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SACRED_TRIBUNAL.title: The Sacred Tribunal
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SCRAP_MAGNET.pages.INIT:
A crane made of junk leans over the heap. From its hook hangs a magnet the size of a cart, [jitter]humming[/jitter] loud enough to rattle your teeth.

Bolts, nails and a spoon leap up to cling to it.

The control booth is empty. The lever is still warm.
You have no cards that can be magnetized.
Procure a random [gold]Potion[/gold]. [blue]{ScrapMagnetRules.ShakeRelicChancePercent}%[/blue]: also obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold]. Otherwise, lose [red]{ScrapMagnetRules.ShakeHpLoss}[/red] HP.
Remove a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Gain [blue]{ScrapMagnetRules.ThrowScrapGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
You have no cards that can be removed.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SCRAP_MAGNET.pages.PULL:
The magnet [jitter]screams[/jitter]. Everything iron you carry tries to leave at once.

When it lets go, your gear keeps tugging at itself.
It doesn't stop.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SCRAP_MAGNET.pages.SHAK:
You grab the cable and shake. The magnet rattles, and a shower of junk comes loose.

Most of it lands on [red]you[/red].
You dig one small bottle out of the pile and limp off.

You grab the cable and shake. The magnet rattles, and a shower of junk comes loose.

Most of it is useless.
Two pieces are [gold]very much not[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SCRAP_MAGNET.pages.THRO:
You hurl junk at the magnet until something gives. A chunk of [gold]scrap[/gold] drops off and lands at your feet.

A scrap dealer would pay for this.
You throw a bit of your own junk away while you're at it.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_SCRAP_MAGNET.title: The Scrap Magnet
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_STILL_MONK.pages.EMPTIE:
[sine][orange]“You carry too much,”[/orange][/sine] he says. It is the only thing he says.

You tip your pack out onto the snow. He points at two things. You leave them there.

You sort it all with bare hands, and the cold gets into your fingers.
It never quite leaves.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_STILL_MONK.pages.INITIA:
Halfway up the pass, you nearly step on a [orange]monk[/orange].

He sits cross-legged in the snow, frost thick on his shoulders and a drift up to his chest. He hasn't moved in days.

One eye opens. He waits.
Lose [red]{StillMonkRules.PackMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Remove [blue]{StillMonkRules.PackCards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
You don't have [blue]{StillMonkRules.PackCards}[/blue] cards you could remove.

Pay [red]{StillMonkRules.ShareGold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. [blue]{StillMonkRules.ShareCards}[/blue] random Attacks or Skills are upgraded and gain [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold] [blue]{StillMonkRules.ShareChakra}[/blue].
You need [red]{StillMonkRules.ShareGold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] and an Attack or Skill to upgrade.

Lose [red]{StillMonkRules.SitHpLoss}[/red] HP. Choose an Attack or Skill: it gains [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold] [blue]{StillMonkRules.SitChakra}[/blue] and [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] [blue]{StillMonkRules.SitColdPerCost}[/blue] per energy it costs.
You need more than [red]{StillMonkRules.SitHpLoss}[/red] HP and an Attack or Skill.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_STILL_MONK.pages.SAT.de:
You sit down beside him. Neither of you speaks.

The cold climbs in through your knees. Somewhere past the shivering, your breathing slows to match his.

When you stand, your hands are steadier.
And very blue.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_STILL_MONK.pages.SHARED:
You build a fire and drag him in close. He thaws a finger at a time.

In return, he corrects your stance. Then your grip. Then your stance again.

He keeps the firewood.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_STILL_MONK.pages.WALKED:
You nod to the monk and keep climbing.

Behind you, the snow fills in your footprints.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_STILL_MONK.sitPrompt: Choose a card to sit with.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_STILL_MONK.title: The Still Monk
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_TITHE_COLLECTOR.pages.C:
You lunge for the bowl. The collector moves faster than something that thin should.

When you wake up, your head hurts and your name is in the ledger.
With [red]interest[/red].
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_TITHE_COLLECTOR.pages.I:
A gaunt figure blocks the path, holding out a golden bowl. One half is full of [gold]coins[/gold]. The other half is full of [red]blood[/red].

“Everyone pays,” it says. “You may choose the currency.”

[blue]{TitheRules.RobChancePercent}%[/blue]: gain [blue]{TitheRules.RobGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Otherwise, lose [red]{TitheRules.RobHpLoss}[/red] HP and add [red]Debt[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Your Max HP is too low.
Lose [red]{TitheRules.BloodTitheHpLoss}[/red] HP. Choose [blue]{TitheRules.BloodTitheGildCount}[/blue] cards to become [gold]Gilded[/gold].
You have no cards that can be [gold]Gilded[/gold], or your HP is too low.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_TITHE_COLLECTOR.pages.P:
You hold your arm over the bowl. The collector is very patient about it.

When you pull back, a few of your things have turned to [gold]gold[/gold].
They feel heavier than they should.

You tip a pile of coins into the bowl. The collector counts every one of them.

It nods, and a strange warmth settles into your bones.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_TITHE_COLLECTOR.pages.R:
You shove the collector and grab the bowl.

It doesn't chase you. It just writes something down.
You're [gold]rich[/gold]. For now.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_TITHE_COLLECTOR.pages.S:
The collector opens a thick ledger and hands you a pen. It has no ink.

You sign anyway. The page drinks it up.
“Your credit is good,” it says.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_TITHE_COLLECTOR.title: The Tithe Collector
She lets out a breath she has been holding for years.

“Then I can put the [gold]material world[/gold] down at last.” She bows, and the long patience of her road settles quietly onto you.

When you look up she is sitting very still, a step nearer [sine][aqua]enlightenment[/aqua][/sine]. The garden she will never see again goes unmentioned.

A woman sits cross-legged beside the road. Dust has settled on her shoulders.

“One more breath and I have it,” she says, eyes shut. “[sine][aqua]Enlightenment[/aqua][/sine]. Then I think of my sister. Of the garden behind her house. And I am back here in the [gold]material world[/gold], counting what I would miss.”

She opens her eyes.

“Tell me honestly. Does the [gold]material world[/gold] matter?”
Lose all [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] ([blue]{PilgrimRules.GoldPerChakra}[/blue] per point).
You have no cards that can gain [gold]{@devas.chakra}[/gold].

Her eyes fill, and she laughs at herself for it.

“I thought so too. [sine][aqua]Enlightenment[/aqua][/sine] can keep.” She unpicks a small [gold]knot of thread[/gold] from her sleeve and folds it into your hand. It is warm, and far heavier than thread.

“Hold on to the world. It will hold on to you.”

You wonder, later, whether she meant that kindly.

The stillness goes out of her like water from a cracked bowl.

“Then I have walked a very long way for [purple]nothing[/purple].” She takes the merit you had been saving towards [sine][aqua]enlightenment[/aqua][/sine] and weighs it in one hand. Then she counts out [gold]coin[/gold] for it, to the last piece.

She leaves for the nearest town. She does not look back.
ZONETHESPIRE-THE_TROUBLED_PILGRIM.title: The Troubled Pilgrim
ZONETHESPIRE-UMBRELLA_SELLER.pages.BOTTL:
He fills a jar from your arm, whistling the whole time.

Then he presses it back into your hands with a wink.
“Keep it. For emergencies.”
ZONETHESPIRE-UMBRELLA_SELLER.pages.BOUGH:
You open the umbrella and the rain stops hitting you. It is very quiet under here.

The merchant counts his coins, whistling.
ZONETHESPIRE-UMBRELLA_SELLER.pages.INITI:
Blood is pouring from the sky. Under a huge black umbrella, a [orange]cheerful merchant[/orange] is perfectly dry.

He has a cart full of umbrellas. And a lot of empty jars.

“Umbrella? Or perhaps you'd like to [red]sell[/red]? I pay well for the good stuff.”
Lose [red]{BloodRainRules.BottleMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Obtain [gold]Jar of Blood[/gold].
Your Max HP is too low.
ZONETHESPIRE-UMBRELLA_SELLER.pages.SHRUG:
You shrug and keep walking through the rain.

It's warm. Oddly [green]soothing[/green], even.
The merchant looks offended.
ZONETHESPIRE-UMBRELLA_SELLER.title: The Umbrella Seller
ZONETHESPIRE-WEEPING_CRYPT.pages.BOTTLED:
You pull out a couple of empty bottles and start grabbing.

The ghosts [red][jitter]bite and scratch[/jitter][/red], but the corks hold.
The jars are still [sine]faintly warm[/sine].
ZONETHESPIRE-WEEPING_CRYPT.pages.INITIAL:
A sealed crypt. It is cold and very damp.

[aqua]Green ghosts[/aqua] drift above the coffins, [sine][purple]whispering to each other[/purple][/sine]. One of them notices you and floats over with its hand out.

You can see straight through it.
It would like something [red]warm[/red], please.
Lose [red]{PhantasmalRules.BottleHpLoss}[/red] HP. Procure [blue]{PhantasmalRules.BottledGhosts}[/blue] [aqua]Ghost in a Jar[/aqua] potions.
Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP. Add [blue]{PhantasmalRules.ProcessionApparitions}[/blue] [gold]Apparitions[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Remove a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. A random other card becomes [gold]{@phantasmal.phantasm_haunted}[/gold].
You have no cards that can be removed.
You fall in line behind the ghosts. They lead you around the crypt. Then around it again.

When they finally let you go, you are [sine][aqua]a little see-through[/aqua][/sine].
Some of you stayed behind.
ZONETHESPIRE-WEEPING_CRYPT.pages.LAID_TO:
You lay a memory in an empty coffin and close the lid. The ghosts [sine][purple]sigh[/purple][/sine] all at once.

On the way out, you notice one of them has [aqua]followed you[/aqua].
It has no plans to leave.
ZONETHESPIRE-WEEPING_CRYPT.title: The Weeping Crypt
ZONETHESPIRE-WRITHING_PIT.nestPrompt: Choose up to [blue]{InfestationRules.NestMaxCards}[/blue] cards to gain [gold]{@infestation.wriggling}[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-WRITHING_PIT.pages.BURNED.d:
You toss a torch into the pit. It goes up with a [jitter][orange]FWOOSH[/orange][/jitter].

While it burns, you throw in something you've been meaning to get rid of.
The smell stays with you.
The floor ends in a [green]pit[/green] full of worms. Thousands of them, [jitter]writhing[/jitter] over each other.

Near the bottom, something [gold]shiny[/gold] is poking out of the mess.

A few worms have already started climbing your boots.
You have no cards that can be removed.
Choose up to [blue]{InfestationRules.NestMaxCards}[/blue] cards to gain [gold]{@infestation.wriggling}[/gold]. Add [red]Infection[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
You have no cards that can gain [gold]{@infestation.wriggling}[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-WRITHING_PIT.pages.NESTED.d:
You stop shaking them off.

The worms crawl up your arms and [green]settle in[/green], warm and busy.
You feel a little [red]itchy[/red].
ZONETHESPIRE-WRITHING_PIT.pages.REACHED_:
You roll up your sleeve and plunge in up to the shoulder.

They [red][jitter]bite[/jitter][/red]. A lot.

You come out holding the [gold]shiny thing[/gold]. You check your sleeve twice.
ZONETHESPIRE-WRITHING_PIT.title: The Writhing Pit
ZONETHESPIRE-YOUR_OWN_FUNERAL.pages.CLIM:
You climb in next to yourself. It's a tight fit.

The mourners close the lid and start [sine]singing[/sine].

Hours later you claw your way out, [red]barely alive[/red].
Dying once has made you [green]harder to kill[/green].
ZONETHESPIRE-YOUR_OWN_FUNERAL.pages.EULO:
You clear your throat and tell them all about you. You were brave. You never once lost a fight.

You leave out one or two [red]embarrassing[/red] parts.
The mourners weep openly.
ZONETHESPIRE-YOUR_OWN_FUNERAL.pages.INIT:
You come across a funeral. A small crowd of [aqua]pale mourners[/aqua] stands around an open coffin, sniffling.

You lean in for a look. The body inside is [sine]you[/sine].

One of the mourners notices you, screams, and faints.
Gain [green]{FuneralRules.ClimbInMaxHp}[/green] Max HP. Your HP becomes [red]{FuneralRules.ClimbInHp}[/red].
Remove a random card from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{FuneralRules.EulogyUpgrades}[/blue] random cards.
You have no cards that can be removed.
Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold]. Procure a random [gold]Potion[/gold]. Gain [blue]{FuneralRules.WillGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Add [red]Doubt[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-YOUR_OWN_FUNERAL.pages.READ:
You find the will tucked into the coffin. It leaves everything to you.

Which is fair.

On the way out you catch your reflection in a puddle and can't tell which of you [purple]made it[/purple].
ZONETHESPIRE-YOUR_OWN_FUNERAL.title: Your Own Funeral
